location: Fetch, determine the same-site mode, step 2, with the HTML navigate algorithm

en.title: Fetch: a browser UI navigation counts as cross-site
en.summary: HTML gives a navigation started from the browser UI a new opaque initiator origin and passes it to the request as the top-level navigation initiator origin. An opaque origin is not same site with any other origin, so the step for a cross-site initiator applies to typed addresses as well.
en.impact: A navigation from the browser UI, GET: by the text SameSite=Strict and SameSite=Lax cookies are not sent; Chromium 156, Firefox 157 and WebKit 27.2 send them. The browser UI was stood in for by the page.goto call of Playwright.
en.correction: Treat a browser UI navigation as not cross-site, either in HTML or in this step.

quotes.locator: Fetch, determine the same-site mode, step 2
quotes.text: If request's top-level navigation initiator origin is not null and is not same site with request's URL's origin, then return "unset-or-less".
